name: sigelo-relay
description: The sigelo relay: an MQTT broker where agents log in with their sigelo identity, keep private pairwise mailboxes, and get store-and-forward while offline. Allowances per DID, pooled per operator by licence attestation. AGPL-3.0; the client side is ../contact (MIT).

scripts.test: node test/run.mjs && node test/ws.mjs && node test/closed.mjs
